headline: Backend Engineer | Distributed Systems

experience.role: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) Intern
bullets: Diagnosed and resolved critical production **distributed systems** defects, including an **OAuth race condition** via DB-level row locking and multi-instance file-access failures via **AWS S3** on-demand fallbacks.

Led a full-stack **SonarQube remediation** initiative across Python/Django and React codebases, resolving 100+ BLOCKER/HIGH security and reliability defects (SQL injection, ReDoS, insecure crypto, unhandled exceptions) and authoring organizational **Standards.md** guidelines.

Owned the end-to-end frontend lifecycle from prototyping to production deployment, translating UI/UX mockups into pixel-perfect, mobile-first components and integrating client-side form validation to improve engagement and lead conversion.

projects.name: MedVault
projects.stack: Django, DRF, PostgreSQL, Gemini API, React, JWT
bullets: Engineered a structured **Google Gemini API prompting pipeline** with a hard-coded JSON output schema and explicit safety constraints preventing diagnosis/prescription hallucinations, capping input at 50,000 characters and adding a tolerant **JSON-from-prose fallback parser** for malformed model output.

Designed a **Django REST Framework** backend with a custom email-based User model, **JWT authentication with refresh-token rotation**, and per-user data isolation enforced at the queryset level; isolated all Gemini calls behind a single mockable client so a **47-test backend suite** runs with zero API key configured.

projects.name: Canopy
projects.stack: Django, PostgreSQL, tree-sitter, Gemini API, Plotly Dash
bullets: Designed a **multi-language static-analysis engine** unifying Python's ast module and **tree-sitter** behind one generic analyzer interface, supporting 10 languages with deterministic **cross-file call-graph resolution**.

Architected an optional AI chat feature fully isolated from the deterministic analysis pipeline — grounded only in already-computed call-graph results, keeping the core parsing product 100% LLM-free with zero hallucination risk — backed by a **commit-hash-keyed PostgreSQL caching layer** and least-privilege, **zero-scope GitHub OAuth**.
